bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the document metadata workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks and used Matplotlib to visualize how metadata group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As part of supervised research, wrote Python functions to parse the provided records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.
Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries, examined recall at fixed cutoffs, and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
